description: TU Delft publishes historical capital-cost and deployment data for alkaline and proton-exchange membrane electrolysers. The source identifies cost evidence from Glenk and Reichelstein and deployment evidence from the 2024 IEA Hydrogen Production and Infrastructure Projects Database. The input tables calibrate forecasts of future electrolyser costs and capacity expansion. Coverage: Temporal coverage is not stated in the reviewed source. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: spreadsheets. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: The workbook and original referenced inputs were not retrieved, and their coverage and consistency were not independently checked. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
